correctness.rationale: Boundary saturation reduces every admissible code to one of 280 templates. Standalone exact checker verifies f2<=20, f1+f2+f3<=36 and sum f<=36 for all templates. For n=4+L with even L, the normalized central coefficient equals (1-r1)f2+(r1-r2)(f1+f2+f3)+r2 sum f, where 0<=r2<=r1<1; hence <=20+16r1. The explicit template has profile (0,8,20,8,0) and attains the bound. Twelve and only twelve maximizing boundary templates have the necessary equalities; their saturated word sets are distinct. The code independently exhausts every word at n=4,6 and uses finite template checking only for the genuinely finite boundary lemma.
